On this day you explore Tughlaq royal architecture and settlement.

Transport from Delhi, the start time, meals and pace are arranged with you, and the quotation states exactly what is included.

What it covers

  • Hisar heritage context
  • Palace/fort publicly accessible areas
  • Historic pillars/mosque area if open
  • Exit interpretation

How the time is spent

  1. Hisar heritage context 25 min

    Explain Firoz Shah Tughlaq urban building.

    You: time-layer map

  2. Palace/fort publicly accessible areas 35 min

    Read courtyard and structural remains.

    You: plan sketch

  3. Historic pillars/mosque area if open 35 min

    Review spolia and conservation.

    You: material notes

  4. Exit interpretation 25 min

    Connect political power and regional infrastructure.

    You: group reflection

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Situate Hisar within its regional historical context.
  • Use observable topography and published evidence to test an interpretation.
  • Produce a concise field record with uncertainty clearly identified.

You take away

A field sheet comparing what you saw.

Where
Hisar, Haryana
For
Individuals, families, schools and institutions
Length
About 2 hours at the site, plus travel from Delhi
When
Any day you choose. October to March is the most comfortable season.
Led by
A regional heritage researcher, with a local guide where needed
Language
English, Hindi or both. Other languages on request, through our partners.
Group size
Agreed with you. Smaller and larger groups are welcome.
Starting point
Delhi, or wherever you are staying in the region.
What to bring
Comfortable shoes, water, a hat and sun protection. Much of the day is outdoors.
